minimumNextSafeStep.action: Do not generate a third repair immediately. Preserve both rejected candidates and evaluate a different asset layout strategy before any new serial generation.
requiredBeforeAnyGeneration: Repeat SHA/size/purpose/runtime-reference dedup audit against existing assets.
Keep the new candidate in evidence/current/tiger-vanguard only until alpha/layout preflight proves 32 independent poses.
Do not bind the candidate by kind=elite and variant=tiger; Tiger Vanguard needs an independent birth identity from ordinary tiger, and bosses remain separate rigs.
Only after a candidate passes preflight may a separate runtime integration and real Edge gameplay gate be considered.
